Oversight / Professional Agency: California Division of Occupational Safety and Health
Training Topic / Competency Item: Training personnel for the proper inspection and maintenance of forging machinery and equipment. The worker shall be instructed in the proper body position when using tongs
Purpose: Ensures personnel properly inspect and maintain forging machinery and that workers use correct body position with tongs
Approval Basis: Bare employer-delivered instruction: the employer trains personnel in inspection and maintenance of forging machinery and instructs the worker in body position when using tongs; the provision names no external approving authority and no program, curriculum or evaluation subject to approval.
